title: The institution may use an LLM to author policy; production policy is a fixed artifact
summary: Operative Security and Institutional Policy are immutable, reviewable, versioned algorithms. An LLM or person may help author them before promotion, but the runtime decision path does not ask a model what seems risky on each submission.
invariants: Identical policy identity + evidence snapshot + action yields deterministic policy evaluation.
Operative policy declares FIXED_REVIEWABLE_VERSIONED_ARTIFACT execution semantics.
Policy changes are new reviewed versions, not prompt edits.
Probabilistic/ML outputs may be evidence inputs; their business consequence is fixed policy.

provenance.claim: Institutional Policy defines fixed, reviewable, versioned policy publication and replay semantics.
Security Effect explicitly has no runtime LLM dependency and uses deterministic policy only.
